dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Rays Da Wroof is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Rays has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to be tense and trembling when handlers attempt to interact with him. With familiar handlers, Ray is receptive to a slow approach and verbal coaxing. While on the street, Ray warms up over time and his tail will become less tucked. Medically, Rays is apparently healthy.

Rays Da Wroof arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Rays has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to be tense and trembling when handlers attempt to interact with him. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
